construct.constructDefinition: 过去两周焦虑相关症状的自述出现频率；未经验证的中文研究译稿。

population.populationNotes: 仅限原成人形式的研究文本审查；不代表本译稿已经适用于任何人群，禁止实际施测。

administration.timeFrame: 过去两周里，以下问题困扰您的频率是多少？
layoutConstraints: 所选为NCBI托管开发者standalone七题原表，不附加原论文中的功能困难问题；仅目录元数据，不提供施测入口。
保留原题顺序、过去两周指导语和0–3锚点；不插入注意力或额外安全筛查题。
中文为AI辅助研究工作译稿，未经验证；独立平台指导语与支持提示尚待实现与审查。

intendedUses.notes: 仅文本、计分和安全方案审查，不供实际施测。

evidence.population: US adult primary-care patients across 15 clinics, ages 18–95; not this translation
evidence.studyDesign: Original English development study; criterion interview subgroup n=965. Abstract reports 2740 and body 2739 participants; no single total sampleSize selected. No exact-version Chinese validation.
evidence.citation: Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JBW, Löwe B. A Brief Measure for Assessing Generalized Anxiety Disorder: The GAD-7. Archives of Internal Medicine. 2006;166(10):1092–1097.
evidence.notes: Original English evidence only. Does not approve this translation, diagnose participants or establish Chinese norms. Article is linked only; instrument permission is not an article redistribution license.

localization.translationSource: New AI-assisted Simplified Chinese working translation from the licensed NCBI-hosted original English GAD-7 standalone seven-item form; exact English/Chinese materials backed up in Notion and docs/scale-instruments/research-drafts/gad7/1.0.0/. Independent AI text review completed with revisions; not human review or developer endorsement.
